tiles.name: Value created (empty: no data yet, waits for work-status-history)

config.sqlTemplate:
-- Note: The count is for work records that you checked. Work that reached `released` and that you did not use is not in this count.
-- Waits for: work-status-history
-- Empty: no data yet (waits for work-status-history)
-- Work records checked by you: the rise of the counter harold.work.checked, by priority.
-- Counter rule: the README rule "The counter rule" in docs/references/telemetry/README.md. Each point rises by its value minus the
-- previous point of its series. A first point, or a point below the previous one (Harold restarted), rises by its whole value.
-- The query reads the points of 21 days: 14 days of two weeks and 7 days before them for the previous point.
-- A week with no point gives no number for that week.
-- Columns: series, this_week, last_week.
SELECT
    Attributes['priority'] AS series,
    if(countIf(TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) = 0, NULL, sumIf(rise, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS this_week,
    if(countIf(TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) = 0, NULL, sumIf(rise, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS last_week
FROM (
    SELECT
        Attributes,
        TimeUnix,
        if(Value >= before, Value - before, Value) AS rise
    FROM (
        SELECT
            Attributes,
            TimeUnix,
            Value,
            lagInFrame(Value, 1, toFloat64(0)) OVER (
                PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes)
                ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS before
        FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
        WHERE MetricName = 'harold.work.checked'
          AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 21 DAY
    )
)
GROUP BY series
HAVING this_week > 0 OR last_week > 0
ORDER BY series

tiles.name: Delivery lead time (work rows: no data yet, waits for work-status-history)

config.sqlTemplate:
-- Note: The slowest work record is the first one to check when the lead time grows.
-- Waits for: work-status-history
-- Empty: work rows: no data yet (waits for work-status-history)
-- Delivery lead time in days, as the p50 of the histogram, by the method of the README panel "Waiting for you, p50":
-- each point gives the mean of the lead times recorded since the previous point (rise of Sum divided by rise of Count).
-- The p50 is the median of these means, weighted by the rise of the Count. Merges are minutes apart and Harold exports every 30 seconds,
-- so a rise holds one lead time. Two lead times within one export would stand as their mean.
-- The rows "work: <phase>" read harold.work.lead_time (idea to your check, by phase).
-- The rows "spec: <phase>" read pod.spec.lead_time (spec time, open to merged). They show a number until the work rows have data.
-- The product filter applies to the "spec:" rows only. A week with no new observation gives no number for that week.
-- Counter rule: the README rule "The counter rule" in docs/references/telemetry/README.md. Each point rises by its value minus the
-- previous point of its series. A first point, or a point below the previous one (Harold restarted), rises by its whole value.
-- The query reads the points of 21 days: 14 days of two weeks and 7 days before them for the previous point.
-- Histogram rule: the same rule on the Count and the Sum. A reset is judged by the Count. Each point gives the rise of the Count and the rise of the Sum.
-- Columns: series, this_week, last_week.
SELECT
    series,
    if(countIf(TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND rise_count > 0) = 0, NULL, quantileExactWeightedIf(0.5)(rise_sum / rise_count / 86400, toUInt64(rise_count), TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND rise_count > 0)) AS this_week,
    if(countIf(TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND rise_count > 0) = 0, NULL, quantileExactWeightedIf(0.5)(rise_sum / rise_count / 86400, toUInt64(rise_count), TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND rise_count > 0)) AS last_week
FROM (
    SELECT
        concat('work: ', Attributes['phase']) AS series,
        TimeUnix,
        rise_count,
        rise_sum
    FROM (
        SELECT
            Attributes,
            TimeUnix,
            if(cnt >= before_cnt, toInt64(cnt) - toInt64(before_cnt), toInt64(cnt)) AS rise_count,
            if(cnt >= before_cnt, total - before_total, total) AS rise_sum
        FROM (
            SELECT
                Attributes,
                TimeUnix,
                Count AS cnt,
                Sum AS total,
                lagInFrame(Count, 1, toUInt64(0)) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes)
                    ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS before_cnt,
                lagInFrame(Sum, 1, toFloat64(0)) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes)
                    ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS before_total
            FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram
            WHERE MetricName = 'harold.work.lead_time'
              AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 21 DAY
        )
    )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        concat('spec: ', Attributes['phase']) AS series,
        TimeUnix,
        rise_count,
        rise_sum
    FROM (
        SELECT
            Attributes,
            TimeUnix,
            if(cnt >= before_cnt, toInt64(cnt) - toInt64(before_cnt), toInt64(cnt)) AS rise_count,
            if(cnt >= before_cnt, total - before_total, total) AS rise_sum
        FROM (
            SELECT
                Attributes,
                TimeUnix,
                Count AS cnt,
                Sum AS total,
                lagInFrame(Count, 1, toUInt64(0)) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes)
                    ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS before_cnt,
                lagInFrame(Sum, 1, toFloat64(0)) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes)
                    ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS before_total
            FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram
            WHERE MetricName = 'pod.spec.lead_time'
              AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 21 DAY
              AND $__filters
        )
    )
)
GROUP BY series
HAVING isNotNull(this_week) OR isNotNull(last_week)
ORDER BY series

-- Note: The oldest spec that awaits approval is over 3 days (72 hours) old when the time you take to approve is too long.
-- Waits for: nothing
-- Work waiting: the newest export of each gauge, summed over the products. A series that Harold stopped to export does not count.
-- This week reads the newest export of the last 7 days. Last week reads the newest export of the 7 days before them.
-- The rows read pod.inventory.item_days (item-days), pod.inventory.items (specs) and pod.inventory.oldest_hours (the oldest spec, shown in days), by list.
-- The row "item-days: all lists" is the total of the item-days. The row "oldest days: all lists" is the oldest age of any list.
-- The row "work records: released" reads harold.work.records at status released, summed over the priorities. It has no product.
-- The product filter applies to the work-waiting rows only. A week with no export gives no number for that week.
-- Columns: series, this_week, last_week.
SELECT
    concat(what, ': ', list) AS series,
    if(countIf(wk = 'this') = 0, NULL, sumIf(v, wk = 'this')) AS this_week,
    if(countIf(wk = 'last') = 0, NULL, sumIf(v, wk = 'last')) AS last_week
FROM (
    SELECT
        'this' AS wk,
        multiIf(MetricName = 'pod.inventory.item_days', 'item-days', MetricName = 'pod.inventory.items', 'specs', 'oldest days') AS what,
        Attributes['list'] AS list,
        if(MetricName = 'pod.inventory.oldest_hours', max(Value) / 24, sum(Value)) AS v
    FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
    WHERE (MetricName, TimeUnix) IN (
          SELECT MetricName, max(TimeUnix) FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
          WHERE MetricName IN ('pod.inventory.item_days', 'pod.inventory.items', 'pod.inventory.oldest_hours') AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
          GROUP BY MetricName
      )
      AND $__filters
    GROUP BY MetricName, list
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'this' AS wk,
        if(MetricName = 'pod.inventory.item_days', 'item-days', 'oldest days') AS what,
        'all lists' AS list,
        if(MetricName = 'pod.inventory.item_days', sum(Value), max(Value) / 24) AS v
    FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
    WHERE (MetricName, TimeUnix) IN (
          SELECT MetricName, max(TimeUnix) FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
          WHERE MetricName IN ('pod.inventory.item_days', 'pod.inventory.oldest_hours') AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
          GROUP BY MetricName
      )
      AND $__filters
    GROUP BY MetricName
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'this' AS wk,
        'work records' AS what,
        'released' AS list,
        sum(Value) AS v
    FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
    WHERE MetricName = 'harold.work.records'
      AND Attributes['status'] = 'released'
      AND TimeUnix = (
          SELECT max(TimeUnix) FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
          WHERE MetricName = 'harold.work.records' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
      )
    GROUP BY MetricName
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'last' AS wk,
        multiIf(MetricName = 'pod.inventory.item_days', 'item-days', MetricName = 'pod.inventory.items', 'specs', 'oldest days') AS what,
        Attributes['list'] AS list,
        if(MetricName = 'pod.inventory.oldest_hours', max(Value) / 24, sum(Value)) AS v
    FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
    WHERE (MetricName, TimeUnix) IN (
          SELECT MetricName, max(TimeUnix) FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
          WHERE MetricName IN ('pod.inventory.item_days', 'pod.inventory.items', 'pod.inventory.oldest_hours') AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
          GROUP BY MetricName
      )
      AND $__filters
    GROUP BY MetricName, list
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'last' AS wk,
        if(MetricName = 'pod.inventory.item_days', 'item-days', 'oldest days') AS what,
        'all lists' AS list,
        if(MetricName = 'pod.inventory.item_days', sum(Value), max(Value) / 24) AS v
    FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
    WHERE (MetricName, TimeUnix) IN (
          SELECT MetricName, max(TimeUnix) FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
          WHERE MetricName IN ('pod.inventory.item_days', 'pod.inventory.oldest_hours') AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
          GROUP BY MetricName
      )
      AND $__filters
    GROUP BY MetricName
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'last' AS wk,
        'work records' AS what,
        'released' AS list,
        sum(Value) AS v
    FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
    WHERE MetricName = 'harold.work.records'
      AND Attributes['status'] = 'released'
      AND TimeUnix = (
          SELECT max(TimeUnix) FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
          WHERE MetricName = 'harold.work.records' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
      )
    GROUP BY MetricName
)
GROUP BY series
HAVING isNotNull(this_week) OR isNotNull(last_week)
ORDER BY series

tiles.name: Waste (failed release attempts: no data yet, waits for release-attempts)

config.sqlTemplate:
-- Note: A day with over 2 slot hours of free slots with work waiting needs a look. So does a spec with over 2 redo hours. A spec with 3 or more revisions after approval was not ready.
-- Waits for: release-attempts
-- Empty: failed release attempts: no data yet (waits for release-attempts)
-- Waste: the hours and the counts of the week.
-- The row "free slots, work waiting (slot hours)" reads pod.slots.idle_with_work: the sum of the points times 30, divided by 3600.
-- The row "redo hours" reads pod.spec.effort at measure redo_hours: the last value of each spec of the week, summed.
-- The rows "revised after approval" read pod.spec.effort at measure revised_after_approval: the specs with at least 1 revision, and the specs counted.
-- A spec counts in a week only when it changed or merged in that week. The README states that pod.spec.effort sends a value on every poll for each spec
-- that is not completed or withdrawn, and for each spec that entered one of those states in the last 30 days. So the points of a spec repeat
-- until the spec changes. A spec changed in a week when its state, its `revisions` value or its `build_worker_hours` value at the end of the week
-- differs from the value at the end of the week before, or when it has no point before the week. A spec that merged in the week changed its state.
-- The row "failed release attempts (hours)" reads agent.harold.release.seconds with the result failed: the rise, divided by 3600. It has no product.
-- It reads the total of the declared counter by the method of agent-counter.sql, because Harold keeps the total of an agent.* counter.
-- The product filter applies to the pod rows only. A source with no point in a week gives no number for that week.
-- Columns: series, this_week, last_week.
WITH
    touched AS (
        SELECT
            spec,
            max(this_changed) AS this_changed,
            max(last_changed) AS last_changed
        FROM (
            SELECT
                Attributes['spec.id'] AS spec,
                argMaxIfOrNull(Value, TimeUnix, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS v2,
                argMaxIfOrNull(Attributes['state'], TimeUnix, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS s2,
                argMaxIfOrNull(Value, TimeUnix, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS v1,
                argMaxIfOrNull(Attributes['state'], TimeUnix, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS s1,
                argMaxIfOrNull(Value, TimeUnix, TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY) AS v0,
                argMaxIfOrNull(Attributes['state'], TimeUnix, TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY) AS s0,
                isNotNull(v2) AND (isNull(v1) AND isNull(v0) OR ifNull(v2 != if(isNull(v1), v0, v1) OR s2 != if(isNull(s1), s0, s1), 1)) AS this_changed,
                isNotNull(v1) AND (isNull(v0) OR ifNull(v1 != v0 OR s1 != s0, 1)) AS last_changed
            FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
            WHERE MetricName = 'pod.spec.effort'
              AND Attributes['measure'] IN ('revisions', 'build_worker_hours')
              AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 28 DAY
              AND $__filters
            GROUP BY Attributes['spec.id'], Attributes['measure']
        )
        GROUP BY spec
    ),
    (SELECT groupArray(spec) FROM touched WHERE this_changed) AS this_specs,
    (SELECT groupArray(spec) FROM touched WHERE last_changed) AS last_specs
SELECT
    series,
    sum(this_value) AS this_week,
    sum(last_value) AS last_week
FROM (
    SELECT
        'free slots, work waiting (slot hours)' AS series,
        if(countIf(TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now()) = 0, NULL, sumIf(Value, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now()) * 30 / 3600) AS this_value,
        if(countIf(TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) = 0, NULL, sumIf(Value, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) * 30 / 3600) AS last_value
    FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
    WHERE MetricName = 'pod.slots.idle_with_work'
      AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY
      AND $__filters
    GROUP BY MetricName
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        r.1 AS series,
        r.2 AS this_value,
        r.3 AS last_value
    FROM (
        SELECT
            Attributes['measure'] AS measure,
            argMaxIfOrNull(Value, TimeUnix, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND has(this_specs, Attributes['spec.id'])) AS this_v,
            argMaxIfOrNull(Value, TimeUnix, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND has(last_specs, Attributes['spec.id'])) AS last_v
        FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
        WHERE MetricName = 'pod.spec.effort'
          AND Attributes['measure'] IN ('redo_hours', 'revised_after_approval')
          AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY
          AND $__filters
        GROUP BY Attributes['measure'], Attributes['spec.id']
    )
    ARRAY JOIN if(
        measure = 'redo_hours',
        [('redo hours', this_v, last_v)],
        [
            ('revised after approval: specs revised', if(isNull(this_v), NULL, toFloat64(this_v >= 1)), if(isNull(last_v), NULL, toFloat64(last_v >= 1))),
            ('revised after approval: specs counted', if(isNull(this_v), NULL, 1.0), if(isNull(last_v), NULL, 1.0))
        ]
    ) AS r
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'failed release attempts (hours)' AS series,
        nullIf((maxIf(Value, TimeUnix <= now()) - maxIf(Value, TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY)) / 3600, 0) AS this_value,
        nullIf((maxIf(Value, TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) - maxIf(Value, TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY)) / 3600, 0) AS last_value
    FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
    WHERE MetricName = 'agent.harold.release.seconds'
      AND Attributes['result'] = 'failed'
      AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 28 DAY
    GROUP BY Attributes
)
GROUP BY series
HAVING isNotNull(this_week) OR isNotNull(last_week)
ORDER BY series

-- Note: A build worker on an Opus model is the first thing to check, because build workers belong on Sonnet. The role `other` above a fifth of the tokens means turns do not reach a pod, and the tokens of subagents are not counted.
-- Waits for: nothing
-- Tokens and turns: the rise of the counters harold.turn.tokens (all four kinds), harold.turns, harold.turn.tokens.by_spec and pod.merges.
-- Counter rule: the README rule "The counter rule" in docs/references/telemetry/README.md. Each point rises by its value minus the
-- previous point of its series. A first point, or a point below the previous one (Harold restarted), rises by its whole value.
-- The query reads the points of 21 days: 14 days of two weeks and 7 days before them for the previous point.
-- A week with no point for a source gives no number for that week, never a 0. Tokens with the model none (the seeded start points) are left out.
-- The rows "share of tokens, <model>" are percentages of all tokens. The row "tokens, build worker on Opus" counts the tokens of the role build_worker on a model whose name has opus.
-- The row "share of tokens, role other" is the percentage of the tokens with the role other.
-- The rows "tokens per merged spec" and "turns per merged spec" divide by the merged specs. A week with no merged spec gives no number.
-- The rows "tokens per merged spec" use harold.turn.tokens.by_spec and pod.merges. They ignore the product filter, because by_spec has no product.
-- The product filter applies to the other rows.
-- Columns: series, this_week, last_week.
WITH r AS (
    SELECT
        'tokens' AS src,
        Attributes['model'] AS model,
        Attributes['role'] AS role,
        if(countIf(TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) = 0, NULL, sumIf(rise, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS this_rise,
        if(countIf(TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) = 0, NULL, sumIf(rise, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS last_rise
    FROM (
        SELECT
            Attributes,
            TimeUnix,
            if(Value >= before, Value - before, Value) AS rise
        FROM (
            SELECT
                Attributes,
                TimeUnix,
                Value,
                lagInFrame(Value, 1, toFloat64(0)) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes)
                    ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS before
            FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
            WHERE MetricName = 'harold.turn.tokens'
              AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 21 DAY
              AND Attributes['model'] != 'none'
              AND $__filters
        )
    )
    GROUP BY model, role
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'turns' AS src,
        '' AS model,
        '' AS role,
        if(countIf(TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) = 0, NULL, sumIf(rise, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS this_rise,
        if(countIf(TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) = 0, NULL, sumIf(rise, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS last_rise
    FROM (
        SELECT
            Attributes,
            TimeUnix,
            if(Value >= before, Value - before, Value) AS rise
        FROM (
            SELECT
                Attributes,
                TimeUnix,
                Value,
                lagInFrame(Value, 1, toFloat64(0)) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes)
                    ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS before
            FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
            WHERE MetricName = 'harold.turns'
              AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 21 DAY
              AND $__filters
        )
    )
    GROUP BY model, role
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'merges' AS src,
        '' AS model,
        '' AS role,
        if(countIf(TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) = 0, NULL, sumIf(rise, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS this_rise,
        if(countIf(TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) = 0, NULL, sumIf(rise, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS last_rise
    FROM (
        SELECT
            Attributes,
            TimeUnix,
            if(Value >= before, Value - before, Value) AS rise
        FROM (
            SELECT
                Attributes,
                TimeUnix,
                Value,
                lagInFrame(Value, 1, toFloat64(0)) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes)
                    ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS before
            FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
            WHERE MetricName = 'pod.merges'
              AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 21 DAY
              AND $__filters
        )
    )
    GROUP BY model, role
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'merges_all' AS src,
        '' AS model,
        '' AS role,
        if(countIf(TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) = 0, NULL, sumIf(rise, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS this_rise,
        if(countIf(TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) = 0, NULL, sumIf(rise, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS last_rise
    FROM (
        SELECT
            Attributes,
            TimeUnix,
            if(Value >= before, Value - before, Value) AS rise
        FROM (
            SELECT
                Attributes,
                TimeUnix,
                Value,
                lagInFrame(Value, 1, toFloat64(0)) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes)
                    ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS before
            FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
            WHERE MetricName = 'pod.merges'
              AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 21 DAY
        )
    )
    GROUP BY model, role
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'by_spec' AS src,
        '' AS model,
        '' AS role,
        if(countIf(TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) = 0, NULL, sumIf(rise, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS this_rise,
        if(countIf(TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) = 0, NULL, sumIf(rise, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS last_rise
    FROM (
        SELECT
            Attributes,
            TimeUnix,
            if(Value >= before, Value - before, Value) AS rise
        FROM (
            SELECT
                Attributes,
                TimeUnix,
                Value,
                lagInFrame(Value, 1, toFloat64(0)) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes)
                    ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS before
            FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
            WHERE MetricName = 'harold.turn.tokens.by_spec'
              AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 21 DAY
        )
    )
    GROUP BY model, role
)
SELECT series, this_week, last_week
FROM (
    SELECT
        'tokens' AS series,
        toFloat64(sum(this_rise)) AS this_week,
        toFloat64(sum(last_rise)) AS last_week
    FROM r
    WHERE src = 'tokens'
    GROUP BY src
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        concat('share of tokens, ', model) AS series,
        100 * sum(this_rise) / nullIf(sum(sum(this_rise)) OVER (), 0) AS this_week,
        100 * sum(last_rise) / nullIf(sum(sum(last_rise)) OVER (), 0) AS last_week
    FROM r
    WHERE src = 'tokens'
    GROUP BY model
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'tokens, build worker on Opus' AS series,
        if(isNull(sum(this_rise)), NULL, toFloat64(ifNull(sumIf(this_rise, role = 'build_worker' AND positionCaseInsensitive(model, 'opus') > 0), 0))) AS this_week,
        if(isNull(sum(last_rise)), NULL, toFloat64(ifNull(sumIf(last_rise, role = 'build_worker' AND positionCaseInsensitive(model, 'opus') > 0), 0))) AS last_week
    FROM r
    WHERE src = 'tokens'
    GROUP BY src
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'share of tokens, role other' AS series,
        100 * sumIf(this_rise, role = 'other') / nullIf(sum(this_rise), 0) AS this_week,
        100 * sumIf(last_rise, role = 'other') / nullIf(sum(last_rise), 0) AS last_week
    FROM r
    WHERE src = 'tokens'
    GROUP BY src
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'turns' AS series,
        toFloat64(sum(this_rise)) AS this_week,
        toFloat64(sum(last_rise)) AS last_week
    FROM r
    WHERE src = 'turns'
    GROUP BY src
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'merged specs' AS series,
        toFloat64(sum(this_rise)) AS this_week,
        toFloat64(sum(last_rise)) AS last_week
    FROM r
    WHERE src = 'merges'
    GROUP BY src
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'tokens per merged spec' AS series,
        sumIf(this_rise, src = 'by_spec') / nullIf(sumIf(this_rise, src = 'merges_all'), 0) AS this_week,
        sumIf(last_rise, src = 'by_spec') / nullIf(sumIf(last_rise, src = 'merges_all'), 0) AS last_week
    FROM r
    WHERE src IN ('by_spec', 'merges_all')
    GROUP BY 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'turns per merged spec' AS series,
        sumIf(this_rise, src = 'turns') / nullIf(sumIf(this_rise, src = 'merges'), 0) AS this_week,
        sumIf(last_rise, src = 'turns') / nullIf(sumIf(last_rise, src = 'merges'), 0) AS last_week
    FROM r
    WHERE src IN ('turns', 'merges')
    GROUP BY 1
)
GROUP BY series, this_week, last_week
HAVING isNotNull(this_week) OR isNotNull(last_week)
ORDER BY series

tiles.name: Slicing and sizing (slices per work record: no data yet, waits for work-status-history)

config.sqlTemplate:
-- Note: Medium specs over 8 hours are the first thing to check. A third or more of the medium specs over 8 hours in a week means the sizes are too small.
-- Waits for: work-status-history
-- Empty: slices per work record: no data yet (waits for work-status-history)
-- Slicing and sizing: the share of the specs of each size that are over the limit of the size, in percent.
-- It reads pod.spec.effort at measure build_worker_hours: the last value of each spec of the week. The limit is 4 hours for small and 8 hours for medium.
-- A spec counts in a week only when it changed or merged in that week. The README states that pod.spec.effort sends a value on every poll for each spec
-- that is not completed or withdrawn, and for each spec that entered one of those states in the last 30 days. So the points of a spec repeat
-- until the spec changes. A spec changed in a week when its state, its `revisions` value or its `build_worker_hours` value at the end of the week
-- differs from the value at the end of the week before, or when it has no point before the week. A spec that merged in the week changed its state.
-- The sizes large and unsized have no limit, so the card has no share for them. The rows "specs counted" give the number of specs of each size.
-- The row "slices per work record" is the mean of the histogram harold.work.slices: the rise of Sum divided by the rise of Count. It has no product.
-- Counter rule: the README rule "The counter rule" in docs/references/telemetry/README.md. Each point rises by its value minus the
-- previous point of its series. A first point, or a point below the previous one (Harold restarted), rises by its whole value.
-- The query reads the points of 21 days: 14 days of two weeks and 7 days before them for the previous point.
-- Histogram rule: the same rule on the Count and the Sum. A reset is judged by the Count. Each point gives the rise of the Count and the rise of the Sum.
-- The product filter applies to the pod.spec.effort rows only. A week with no number for a row gives no number for that week.
-- Columns: series, this_week, last_week.
WITH
    touched AS (
        SELECT
            spec,
            max(this_changed) AS this_changed,
            max(last_changed) AS last_changed
        FROM (
            SELECT
                Attributes['spec.id'] AS spec,
                argMaxIfOrNull(Value, TimeUnix, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS v2,
                argMaxIfOrNull(Attributes['state'], TimeUnix, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS s2,
                argMaxIfOrNull(Value, TimeUnix, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS v1,
                argMaxIfOrNull(Attributes['state'], TimeUnix, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS s1,
                argMaxIfOrNull(Value, TimeUnix, TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY) AS v0,
                argMaxIfOrNull(Attributes['state'], TimeUnix, TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY) AS s0,
                isNotNull(v2) AND (isNull(v1) AND isNull(v0) OR ifNull(v2 != if(isNull(v1), v0, v1) OR s2 != if(isNull(s1), s0, s1), 1)) AS this_changed,
                isNotNull(v1) AND (isNull(v0) OR ifNull(v1 != v0 OR s1 != s0, 1)) AS last_changed
            FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
            WHERE MetricName = 'pod.spec.effort'
              AND Attributes['measure'] IN ('revisions', 'build_worker_hours')
              AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 28 DAY
              AND $__filters
            GROUP BY Attributes['spec.id'], Attributes['measure']
        )
        GROUP BY spec
    ),
    (SELECT groupArray(spec) FROM touched WHERE this_changed) AS this_specs,
    (SELECT groupArray(spec) FROM touched WHERE last_changed) AS last_specs
SELECT
    series,
    sum(this_value) AS this_week,
    sum(last_value) AS last_week
FROM (
    SELECT
        'specs counted: ' || size AS series,
        if(countIf(isNotNull(this_v)) = 0, NULL, toFloat64(countIf(isNotNull(this_v)))) AS this_value,
        if(countIf(isNotNull(last_v)) = 0, NULL, toFloat64(countIf(isNotNull(last_v)))) AS last_value
    FROM (
        SELECT
            Attributes['spec.size'] AS size,
            argMaxIfOrNull(Value, TimeUnix, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND has(this_specs, Attributes['spec.id'])) AS this_v,
            argMaxIfOrNull(Value, TimeUnix, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND has(last_specs, Attributes['spec.id'])) AS last_v
        FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
        WHERE MetricName = 'pod.spec.effort'
          AND Attributes['measure'] = 'build_worker_hours'
          AND Attributes['spec.size'] IN ('small', 'medium')
          AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY
          AND $__filters
        GROUP BY Attributes['spec.size'], Attributes['spec.id']
    )
    GROUP BY size
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'over limit, share of specs (%): ' || size AS series,
        100.0 * countIf(this_v > if(size = 'small', 4, 8)) / nullIf(countIf(isNotNull(this_v)), 0) AS this_value,
        100.0 * countIf(last_v > if(size = 'small', 4, 8)) / nullIf(countIf(isNotNull(last_v)), 0) AS last_value
    FROM (
        SELECT
            Attributes['spec.size'] AS size,
            argMaxIfOrNull(Value, TimeUnix, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND has(this_specs, Attributes['spec.id'])) AS this_v,
            argMaxIfOrNull(Value, TimeUnix, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND has(last_specs, Attributes['spec.id'])) AS last_v
        FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
        WHERE MetricName = 'pod.spec.effort'
          AND Attributes['measure'] = 'build_worker_hours'
          AND Attributes['spec.size'] IN ('small', 'medium')
          AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY
          AND $__filters
        GROUP BY Attributes['spec.size'], Attributes['spec.id']
    )
    GROUP BY size
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'slices per work record' AS series,
        if(countIf(TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND rise_count > 0) = 0, NULL, sumIf(rise_sum, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND rise_count > 0) / sumIf(rise_count, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND rise_count > 0)) AS this_value,
        if(countIf(TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND rise_count > 0) = 0, NULL, sumIf(rise_sum, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND rise_count > 0) / sumIf(rise_count, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND rise_count > 0)) AS last_value
    FROM (
        SELECT
            Attributes,
            TimeUnix,
            if(cnt >= before_cnt, toInt64(cnt) - toInt64(before_cnt), toInt64(cnt)) AS rise_count,
            if(cnt >= before_cnt, total - before_total, total) AS rise_sum
        FROM (
            SELECT
                Attributes,
                TimeUnix,
                Count AS cnt,
                Sum AS total,
                lagInFrame(Count, 1, toUInt64(0)) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes)
                    ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS before_cnt,
                lagInFrame(Sum, 1, toFloat64(0)) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes)
                    ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS before_total
            FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram
            WHERE MetricName = 'harold.work.slices'
              AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 21 DAY
        )
    )
    GROUP BY series
)
GROUP BY series
HAVING isNotNull(this_week) OR isNotNull(last_week)
ORDER BY series

tiles.name: Test and release time (empty: no data yet, waits for release-attempts)

config.sqlTemplate:
-- Note: An ok release attempt over 70 minutes needs a look. So do 2 failed release attempts in a week.
-- Waits for: release-attempts
-- Empty: no data yet (waits for release-attempts)
-- Test and release time: the rise of the counters agent.harold.release.seconds and agent.harold.release.attempts.
-- The rows "ok minutes per attempt, <step>" are the rise of the seconds of the result ok at the step, divided by 60 and by the ok attempts of the week.
-- The row "ok minutes per attempt, all steps" is the sum of those rows.
-- The row "failed attempts" is the rise of the attempts with the result failed. The row "ok attempts" is the rise of the attempts with the result ok.
-- An attempt with the result stopped is in neither row.
-- The counters are declared agent.* counters. Harold keeps their totals, so the query reads totals by the method of agent-counter.sql.
-- A series is one result and one step, so the query takes the rise of each series before it sums. The card has no product.
-- A week with no ok attempt gives no minutes for that week. Columns: series, this_week, last_week.
WITH
    (
        SELECT sum(rise) FROM (
            SELECT greatest(toInt64(maxIf(Value, TimeUnix <= now()) - maxIf(Value, TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY)), 0) AS rise
            FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
            WHERE MetricName = 'agent.harold.release.attempts'
              AND Attributes['result'] = 'ok'
              AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 28 DAY
            GROUP BY Attributes
        )
    ) AS ok_this,
    (
        SELECT sum(rise) FROM (
            SELECT greatest(toInt64(maxIf(Value, TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) - maxIf(Value, TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY)), 0) AS rise
            FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
            WHERE MetricName = 'agent.harold.release.attempts'
              AND Attributes['result'] = 'ok'
              AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 28 DAY
            GROUP BY Attributes
        )
    ) AS ok_last
SELECT
    series,
    sum(this_value) AS this_week,
    sum(last_value) AS last_week
FROM (
    SELECT
        concat('ok minutes per attempt, ', label) AS series,
        this_rise / 60 / nullIf(ok_this, 0) AS this_value,
        last_rise / 60 / nullIf(ok_last, 0) AS last_value
    FROM (
        SELECT
            Attributes['step'] AS step,
            greatest(maxIf(Value, TimeUnix <= now()) - maxIf(Value, TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY), 0) AS this_rise,
            greatest(maxIf(Value, TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) - maxIf(Value, TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY), 0) AS last_rise
        FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
        WHERE MetricName = 'agent.harold.release.seconds'
          AND Attributes['result'] = 'ok'
          AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 28 DAY
        GROUP BY Attributes
    )
    ARRAY JOIN [step, 'all steps'] AS label
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        if(Attributes['result'] = 'ok', 'ok attempts', 'failed attempts') AS series,
        toFloat64(greatest(toInt64(maxIf(Value, TimeUnix <= now()) - maxIf(Value, TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY)), 0)) AS this_value,
        toFloat64(greatest(toInt64(maxIf(Value, TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) - maxIf(Value, TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY)), 0)) AS last_value
    FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
    WHERE MetricName = 'agent.harold.release.attempts'
      AND Attributes['result'] IN ('ok', 'failed')
      AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 28 DAY
    GROUP BY Attributes
)
GROUP BY series
HAVING this_week > 0 OR last_week > 0
ORDER BY series

-- Note: None. The card shows the merged specs of each product.
-- Waits for: nothing
-- Merged specs for each product: the rise of the counter pod.merges, summed over the series of the product.
-- A series is one spec.id, so a new spec.id rises by its whole value.
-- Counter rule: the README rule "The counter rule" in docs/references/telemetry/README.md. Each point rises by its value minus the
-- previous point of its series. A first point, or a point below the previous one (Harold restarted), rises by its whole value.
-- The query reads the points of 21 days: 14 days of two weeks and 7 days before them for the previous point.
-- Columns: series, this_week, last_week.
SELECT
    Attributes['pod.product'] AS series,
    if(countIf(TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) = 0, NULL, sumIf(rise, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS this_week,
    if(countIf(TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) = 0, NULL, sumIf(rise, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS last_week
FROM (
    SELECT
        Attributes,
        TimeUnix,
        if(Value >= before, Value - before, Value) AS rise
    FROM (
        SELECT
            Attributes,
            TimeUnix,
            Value,
            lagInFrame(Value, 1, toFloat64(0)) OVER (
                PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes)
                ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS before
        FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
        WHERE MetricName = 'pod.merges'
          AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 21 DAY
          AND $__filters
    )
)
GROUP BY series
HAVING this_week > 0 OR last_week > 0
ORDER BY series

-- Note: None. The card shows the agents that work now, of all agents.
-- Waits for: nothing
-- Agents now: the newest export of each gauge. A series that Harold stopped to export does not count.
-- This week reads the newest export of the last 7 days. Last week reads the newest export of the 7 days before them.
-- The rows "<product>: working" and "<product>: all" read pod.agents, summed over the roles. "all" counts every state.
-- The rows "all Harold agents: working" and "all Harold agents: all" read harold.agents, summed over the providers and the Rex hosts. They have no product.
-- The product filter applies to the pod.agents rows only. A week with no export gives no number for that week.
-- Columns: series, this_week, last_week.
SELECT
    concat(product, ': ', kind) AS series,
    if(countIf(wk = 'this') = 0, NULL, sumIf(v, wk = 'this')) AS this_week,
    if(countIf(wk = 'last') = 0, NULL, sumIf(v, wk = 'last')) AS last_week
FROM (
    SELECT
        'this' AS wk,
        if(Attributes['pod.product'] = '', 'no product', Attributes['pod.product']) AS product,
        Attributes['state'] AS state,
        sum(Value) AS v
    FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
    WHERE MetricName = 'pod.agents'
      AND TimeUnix = (
          SELECT max(TimeUnix) FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
          WHERE MetricName = 'pod.agents' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
      )
      AND $__filters
    GROUP BY product, state
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'this' AS wk,
        'all Harold agents' AS product,
        Attributes['state'] AS state,
        sum(Value) AS v
    FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
    WHERE MetricName = 'harold.agents'
      AND TimeUnix = (
          SELECT max(TimeUnix) FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
          WHERE MetricName = 'harold.agents' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
      )
    GROUP BY product, state
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'last' AS wk,
        if(Attributes['pod.product'] = '', 'no product', Attributes['pod.product']) AS product,
        Attributes['state'] AS state,
        sum(Value) AS v
    FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
    WHERE MetricName = 'pod.agents'
      AND TimeUnix = (
          SELECT max(TimeUnix) FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
          WHERE MetricName = 'pod.agents' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
      )
      AND $__filters
    GROUP BY product, state
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'last' AS wk,
        'all Harold agents' AS product,
        Attributes['state'] AS state,
        sum(Value) AS v
    FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
    WHERE MetricName = 'harold.agents'
      AND TimeUnix = (
          SELECT max(TimeUnix) FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
          WHERE MetricName = 'harold.agents' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
      )
    GROUP BY product, state
)
ARRAY JOIN if(state = 'working', ['working', 'all'], ['all']) AS kind
GROUP BY series
HAVING isNotNull(this_week) OR isNotNull(last_week)
ORDER BY series

tiles.name: Clarification requests per day, by cause (empty: no data yet, waits for telemetry-record-tool)

config.sqlTemplate:
-- Note: Any day above 3 means the chief's writing needs a look (info only).
-- Waits for: telemetry-record-tool
-- Empty: no data yet (waits for telemetry-record-tool)
-- Clarification requests: the rise of the counter agent.chief.clarification_requests, by cause (unknown_term, no_refresher, unchecked_claim, other).
-- The rows with the cause "all" are the total of all causes for each day. "Any day above 3" reads on the row "busiest day: all".
-- The counter is a declared agent.* counter. Harold keeps its total, so the query reads totals by the method of agent-counter.sql.
-- The rows "per day, mean" are the rise of the week divided by 7. The rows "busiest day" are the largest rise of one day in the week.
-- A day is 24 hours back from now, not a calendar day. The counter has no product, so the product filter does not apply.
-- Until the chief declares the counter, or while it stays at 0, the card has no row.
-- Columns: series, this_week, last_week.
WITH per_cause AS (
    SELECT
        Attributes['cause'] AS cause,
        d,
        greatest(toInt64(maxIf(Value, TimeUnix <= now() - toIntervalDay(d)) - maxIf(Value, TimeUnix <= now() - toIntervalDay(d + 1))), 0) AS day_rise
    FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
    ARRAY JOIN range(14) AS d
    WHERE MetricName = 'agent.chief.clarification_requests'
      AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 28 DAY
    GROUP BY Attributes, d
)
SELECT series, this_week, last_week
FROM (
    SELECT
        r.1 AS series,
        toFloat64(r.2) AS this_week,
        toFloat64(r.3) AS last_week
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cause,
            sumIf(day_rise, d < 7) AS this_total,
            sumIf(day_rise, d >= 7) AS last_total,
            maxIf(day_rise, d < 7) AS this_max,
            maxIf(day_rise, d >= 7) AS last_max
        FROM (
            SELECT cause, d, day_rise FROM per_cause
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'all' AS cause, d, sum(day_rise) AS day_rise FROM per_cause GROUP BY d
        )
        GROUP BY cause
        HAVING this_total > 0 OR last_total > 0
    )
    ARRAY JOIN [
        (concat('per day, mean: ', cause), this_total / 7, last_total / 7),
        (concat('busiest day: ', cause), toFloat64(this_max), toFloat64(last_max))
    ] AS r
)
GROUP BY series, this_week, last_week
ORDER BY series
